body:
Source pin discovery now consumes ordered guarded card observations, retaining at most 101 pin ID/position pairs instead of all parsed bodies. Existing leases, file validation, archived membership, ordering, source/pin bounds and command durability remain. The actual 50,001/50,000-card and 101/100-pin regression passes.

On M4/macOS release context fixtures with 1,000 long-body cards, incremental live Rust allocation falls from 63.35–63.42 MiB to 0.96–1.15 MiB. Whole-process peak RSS falls only about 5 MiB; matched context medians cost 0.25–1.22 ms more. The change is retained for bounded memory, without claiming faster readiness. All 480 selected latency observations retain result/version/budget checks.

The full gate passes 462 tests and normally paired Chromium/WebKit Focus/protocol checks pass. Application cfc35c1ea6908725701ef9178157f3a4e09de4e3 is rebuilt and running at the existing HTTPS address. Verification preserves 71 prior resource versions, two pins, settings, certificate, epoch and complete normalized CLI context; all 32 served assets match. The unrelated owner card remains unchanged. Broader perceived performance and platform/release acceptance remain open. Details: progress/2026-10-01-source-focus-stream.md.

metadata.summary: Source pin discovery retains bounded memory with ordinary source validation
